summary: 3x3 pattern lock with a pixel trail; skipped middle nodes join automatically, a wrong pattern shatters and falls, a right one turns green.

attributes.name: pattern
attributes.description: The correct pattern as comma-separated node indexes 0 to 8, row by row from the top left, each at most once; a missing or invalid value uses the L `0,3,6,7,8`. List every node the line passes through, because skipped middle nodes join a drawn pattern. Read when a pattern is checked and when Show me runs; the "draw an L" hint shows only for the default.

events.name: unlock
events.description: Fires when the drawn pattern matches `pattern`.

events.name: fail
events.description: Fires when a pattern of two or more nodes does not match.

methods.description: Draws the correct pattern node by node, then checks it. Ignored while already running or after a correct pattern.
Clears the current pattern, stops Show me and returns to the idle prompt.

properties.name: secret
properties.description: The `pattern` attribute parsed into node indexes; the default L when it is missing or invalid.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"` and `aria-label="Pattern lock. Use Show me to watch the right pattern."`.
The status text under the grid is an `aria-live="polite"` region that reports success or "Wrong pattern".
Drawing requires a pointer; "Show me" is a native button.
motion: With reduced motion, the wrong-pattern shake and the success sparks are skipped and the rings around selected nodes do not turn; the falling debris still animates.
notes: The match is exact and ordered, and the pattern is checked in the browser from a visible attribute, so this is a UI pattern, not a security control.
The default pattern is an L. The host carries `data-state="ok"` or `data-state="wrong"`; it resets 2.4 seconds after a match and 1.2 seconds after a failure.
The canvas is a fixed 216 by 216px.
